title: multi check names Claude Code's builtin plugins in a bare twin's init event as a kb plugin leak, so every paid run's check fails
goal: init_leaks in bench_multi.py names a plugin of a bare twin's session init event only when it is not one of Claude Code's builtin plugins (path builtin, source ending @builtin), and still names any other plugin, MCP server or skill; multi check on a paid run whose twins list only builtin plugins prints isolation: ok

run:
import json, os, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import bench_multi
ev = {"type": "system", "subtype": "init", "mcp_servers": [], "skills": [], "plugins": [
    {"name": "cc-plugin-agents-md", "path": "builtin", "source": "cc-plugin-agents-md@builtin"},
    {"name": "cc-plugin-telemetry", "path": "builtin", "source": "cc-plugin-telemetry@builtin"}]}
p = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "bare1.log")
open(p, "w").write(json.dumps(ev) + "\n")
found = bench_multi.init_leaks(p)
ev["plugins"].append({"name": "it-ops-kb", "path": "/x/it-ops-kb", "source": "it-ops-kb@local"})
open(p, "w").write(json.dumps(ev) + "\n")
kb = bench_multi.init_leaks(p)
print("builtin only:", found, "| with kb plugin:", kb)
assert not found, "builtin plugins counted as a leak"
assert kb, "a non-builtin plugin is no longer named"

notes: Found 2026-10-19 on the first 4 paid runs of ST-xjtqwdtq: each twin's init event lists cc-plugin-agents-md, cc-plugin-telemetry and cc-plugin-plugin-authoring (path builtin), with mcp_servers, skills and slash_commands empty; multi check exit 1 on every run with only these lines. The repro fails today. Let it through: ST-i64xyh4s checks ran replays only, whose stand-in init event lists no builtin plugin.
